title: Longitudinal and Time-Series Trend Analysis
description: Exploration of temporal patterns, seasonality, autocorrelation, and regime shifts in time-stamped records.
conditions: Sequential observations indexed by timestamp or chronological epoch
Need to identify macro trends, weekly/monthly seasonality, or abrupt anomalies
recommended_methods: Rolling moving average and exponential smoothing trend lines
Classical additive or multiplicative seasonal decomposition (STL)
selection_rules: If seasonal amplitude grows proportionally with trend level, select Multiplicative decomposition over Additive
If data exhibits significant gap intervals, resample onto regular grid (daily, hourly) before autocorrelation
If ACF displays slow linear decay, series is non-stationary and requires differencing
limitations: Decomposition boundary endpoints suffer from edge-effect distortion
Sudden structural regime shifts (e.g. regulatory policy change) violate smooth seasonality models
